item.text:
The audit now has protocol-level confirmation of the LFU defect, in addition to 27 total findings.

In a three-node run, after follower 3 was resynchronized from the leader’s non-empty LFU cache:

- leader entry 7: `{ id: 7, key: "A" }`
- follower entry 7: `{ id: 7, key: "C" }`

The replicas reported the same decided index but stored different application values, directly violating replication agreement: [audit_lfu_protocol.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/omnipaxos/tests/audit_lfu_protocol.rs).

Other highest-impact findings remain delta-snapshot corruption, `AcceptSync` decided-index regression, persistent failed-write leakage and data deletion, timeout retry duplication, and LRU bincode deserialization failure.

Full evidence, code locations, reproduction commands, and retained logs are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
